book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 KORIN Pol pepa muno namba 1 bogl Korin yomba tongwa

content: Kamambuno kongun erikwa yomba, ye God nigl-kongunmo

Angrima wagle, na ene ka diteingwa i yomba Holi Spirit bogl meglkwa diteimere yegl ene ditekrika. Tamanga. Makandle yomba mambuno goglo bogl meglko ka diteimere yegl ene diteingwa. Sraglpre, Krais embriye mambunomo i mina ene gak kuglambu mereyegl meglkwa.
Na am nuglo ene teinga kaiya mokna gigle dungwa tekrika. Sraglpre, ene kaiya mokna gigle dungwa ninaglkwa kuno erekrukwa. Kaima, erme ama ninaglkwa kuno erekrukwa.

Sraglpre, ene makandle mambuno goglo i mina mogl paingwa. Kaima, enene mina angro ta pre nangiye ka-sindre te nonga dingwa i ene mina paimoglkwa. Mambuno goglo i makandle yomba mambunono ene mina pangwa.
Ana ene mina ta yegl dungwa, “Na Apolos yombamo.” Te ta yegl dungwa, “Na Pol yombamo.” Ka yegl dingwa ipre ene makan yomba yoko meglmere yegl ene mogl paingwa.
Ana ene piryo. Apolos ye ira? Te Pol, na ira? No suwo-akiye God nigl kongunmo yomba mouglka. Yaglkande no kongun noro perepere endungwa. Ana no kongun ouglara i mina ene Krais pirngi dingwa.
Na mokna mongo yaglko, te Apolos nigl engre boglkwa, ba God yene kongunmo orko ana mokna mongo boglkwa.
Ipre ereyaglkwa yagle ye kangiye paikrukwa, te nigl engre boglkwa yagle ye ama kangiye paikrukwa. God yene kongunmo orko taragl bogl kande ongwa. Ye suwara kaima kangiye pangwa.
Ana ereyaglkwa yagle ya nigl engre boglkwa yagle ye kokunkuno miurka. Ye suwara suwarandi kongun eurere topo inambirka.
No tapsi God kongunmo ouglka. Ana ene God kaiya moknamo togl ya yungumo meglkwa.
Kamambuno kongun erikwa yomba ye yungu keingwa mereyegl meglkwa

God wakaimo narkwa i mina na yungu wakai keingwa mereyegl mogltre ana yungu keinaglka pre kombuglo kauglange epigl erika. Ana yomba ta yungu bolamugl igle keingwa. Ba ye suwara suwarandi yungu sraglmere keinaglkwa i kanpogl sindre keinaglkwa.
Sraglpre, yungu kauglange pai-kondungwa, i Yesus Krais. Ana yomba ye kauglange kor ta sikraglkwa.
Ana kauglange i mina yomba tau, gol ya silva ya kombuglo topo kande boglkwa indre yungu keinaglkwa, te yomba tau endekondo ya indaun ya wit buglo indre keinaglkwa.

Ana okuwo enge kande mina God yomba ka-tange tenambuka enge, yomba konguno erikwa i prapra wu pene enambuka. Engemo i dongwa bauglo mereyegl wu pene enambuka, ana yomba yungu gigle dungwa mo kunambu orkwa keingwa i donga yene eregagl kanambuka. Kongun wakai erikwa mo kinde i nono kanamga.
Yomba ta yungu kauglange i mina yungu bolamugl keinan ana donga detenge erekre yoko paimoran ana ye topo inambuka.
Yomba ta yungumo endi donga de kondinan ye topo ikrambuka, ba ye yene ere-inambuka, yombamo i endi donga bauglo mina suna moglko imenda endingwa mereyegl moglkwa.
Ene God yungumo holi meglkwa
Ene God yungumo holi meglko ana God Spiritmo ene mina suna moglkwa. I ene pirkrimo?
Yomba ta God yungumo holi i erekinde erambuka, ana God eremogl yombamo i erekinde erambuka. Sraglpre, God yungumo i holi yongwa. Yungumo holi i ene meglkwa.
Nono yomba dembino sikramga

Aglau eran enene kakimbi di i-dinaglmiwo. Ana ene mina suna i yomba ta yene eremogl enge erme mambuno kanekane i duglo bogl ana nomana pai pogl sumedi piran, ye wu nomano pai pogl sikrukwa du mereyegl enambuka. Te yomba ta na nomana pai pogl sikrumedi pirambuka, ye nomane pai pogl sungwa.
Makandle yomba nomane pai pogl sungwa ye kanno i God ongumuglo wagle wu dorugl ongwa. Ka ta yegl beglko pangwa: “Nomano pai pogl sungwa yomba ye yene mambuno erimara i ere endungo kitn singwa.”
Ka ta ama yegl beglko pangwa: “Makan yomba pirpogl singwa ye nomano Yaglkande kangwa wu taragl yoko ongwa.”
Ipre ene yomba ta pre dembino sikraglkwa. Taragl prapra i ene taratno yongwa.
Ana Pol ya Apolos ya Pita, te makan mina kor-mounga mo gounga, te enge erme mo okuwo imbor, i prapra ene taratno yongwa.
Ana Krais yombama ene meglko te Krais ye God yombamo moglkwa.

footnotes.text: 1 Korin 1:12 ya 3:4 mina Pol ka yegl dungwa, Korin yomba ende wu perepere pi yegl dingwa, “Na Pol yombamo” te “Na Apolos yombamo.” Ba ka yeglmere i makandle yomba nomane pamere duglo beglkwa. Ana Korin yomba God nomanemo ta pirkan erima, ye yegl digo, “Pol no yombano” te “Apolos no yombano”. Sraglpre, God eremogl Pol indre Apolos indre ana Korin yomba akeple dimbir ana ye wu Krais epiglmo kaima enaglkwa. 1 Korin 3:1-9 ombugl kanamga.
